proposal.reason: Main change is a substantial overhaul of open-source test workflows and tooling: dual-platform (M890P/810E) daily/PR execution, trusted HPN SDK selection/install, platform-aware case generation/grouping, device mapping in run executor, reconciliation/reporting/artifact handling, and extensive xtest coverage updates (including large patch-omitted test-list definitions). These are CI execution/orchestration changes rather than production runtime modules.
